history.note: First verdict on this item; same non-author render of 973a21e as U02. The screen reads as the same visual family as the reference menus: a dark warm wood ground, gold scrollwork at the top corners, gold-framed slots, a warm cream serif for the item name and crisp text throughout at 1280 px. Nits: the reference's carved frame is a heavy band running the full width under the tab bar while ours is a thin flourish at each corner only, so ours is markedly less ornate; and the left grid's cell shapes are inconsistent.
